Subject: Execution acceptance runbook + starter day lane

Hi Anna / Oliver —

Thanks again for the time today. Attached is the latest mutual action plan (Elmwood_MAP_v3.xlsx) and the draft SOW (SOW_Elmwood_v1.pdf). To keep the schedule tight we propose the following condensed acceptance/runbook timeline and decision gates: 

- Procurement PO by: 2026-11-14 (procurement to confirm)
- Legal redline resolution complete: 2026-11-12
- Final exec go/no-go meeting: 2026-11-15 10:00 PT (30m) — decision required
- DocuSign window opens: 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-19 (two signer-window options)
- Target start date (onboarding day 0): 2026-11-22

Key asks from Elmwood: please confirm the PO owner and whether procurement needs an approved SOW + annex for the PO to be issued. If procurement needs any additional compliance evidence (SOC2 evidence or data residency notes), flag that now so we can attach it to the packet.

Camila / Karthik: once Anna confirms procurement owner, please lock the DocuSign packet and set signer routing per the MAP (exec sign -> procurement). Kimberly, note there is one outstanding CCPA-related clause Anna flagged; we should propose final language by 11/11.

Attaching MAP and SOW for visibility. I’ll follow up with the DocuSign link once legal signs off.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Elmwood_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_Elmwood_v1.pdf (pdf)

Vanessa — thanks for the clear timeline and the docs. A few quick points from procurement side: 

1) PO owner is me (Anna Chen) but final issuance will need signoff from Procurement (cc'd) and Legal. I can circulate our internal PO template — we prefer SOW attached as an exhibit.
2) Compliance: Procurement asked for a short SOC2 summary and retention SLA; does Redwood have a 1-page snapshot we can attach?
3) We will aim for the 11/14 PO target but need final SOW + redline resolution by 11/11 to meet our internal review cadence.

We are aligned on the 11/15 decision meeting. Oliver will be our operations lead for day-zero planning and will join the call.

Anna
Director, Procurement
Elmwood Retail

Subject: FINAL: Execution acceptance runbook + starter day lane — signoff actions

Team —

Appreciate everyone moving quickly this week. Below is final lock-down of the runbook and immediate next steps ahead of the 11/15 decision meeting. Please treat this as the source of truth for the signflow: 

1) Legal: Kimberly to confirm language by 2026-11-11 EOD. If no objections are raised, we mark legal cleared.
2) Procurement: Anna to target PO issuance by 2026-11-14 COB. If PO delayed beyond 11/14, fallback: temporary SOW start with underwriting holdback (documented in MAP).
3) Go/No-Go call: 2026-11-15 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Required voting attendees: Elmwood Procurement (Anna), Elmwood Ops (Oliver), Redwood Account Exec (Camila), Redwood Legal (Kimberly), Redwood CS (Laura). Voting options: GO / HOLD / ESCALATE.
4) DocuSign windows (choose one): 2026-11-16 09:00–12:00 PT OR 2026-11-19 13:00–17:00 PT. DocuSign packet will include SOW, MAP, and an onboarding checklist. Link will be sent after legal cleared.
5) Day-0 kickoff: Target 2026-11-22. Laura to publish the day-0 attendee list and a 90-minute agenda 48 hours prior to kickoff.

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/ELM-2026-1498) and proposed DocuSign packet (https://www.docusign.com/teams/elmwood/packet/12345).

If Elmwood confirms the PO owner and SOC2 summary request today, we will meet the 11/14 PO target and proceed to DocuSign on 11/16. If any party needs to escalate the timeline, reply-all with the blocker and suggested mitigation.

Thanks — final push here.
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
